### lex.yy.c

```c
/* A lexical scanner generated by flex */

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

int vowels = 0;
int consonants = 0;

int yylex(void);
int yywrap(void);

int main()
{
    printf("Enter a sentence: ");
    yylex();

    printf("\nNumber of vowels = %d", vowels);
    printf("\nNumber of consonants = %d\n", consonants);

    return 0;
}

int yywrap()
{
    return 1;
}
```
